newsitem.title: MEXICO: Pemex to launch new catalytic plant in July.
newsitem.headline: Pemex to launch new catalytic plant in July.

text.p: State-owned oil monopoly Petroleos Mexicanos (Pemex) said on Thursday it will launch a new catalytic plant in its Cadereyta refinery in July, boosting high-octane gasoline output.
"With the start up of this plant, we will produce four million barrels annually of high-octane gasoline and two million of light ethylene," Pemex said in a statement.
The Cadereyta refinery is one of Mexico's main sources of high-octane gasoline, known as "Premium" that is promoted as a low-polluting energy source.

In August, Pemex plans to tender the expansion and modernization of the Cadereyta refinery, a project that is expected to cost $1.2 billion and could boost heavy Maya crude output to 270,000 barrils per day from 235,000 bpd.
